notes: Clean TRAIN30 environment, final outcome rule (user decision of 2026-10-02): the judge of v12 (gpt-4o-mini, diagnosis_equivalence_v4.txt, temperature 0) with the decision policy majority-v1: a pair is decided by votes of this one judge, the majority of three, and the majority of five when the first two votes differ; no other model votes. The pairs of the base collaborations and label continuations were decided once (scripts/majority_equivalence.py; mapping hash in diagnosis_judge_frozen); a pair first seen later is decided the same way and frozen. Every dialogue of v11 is reused unchanged; labels, predictor, rubrics and GRPO are made again. v12 (single-call decisions) is kept and not used. No human adjudication; Sol is an independent audit only. The rule is not changed after any DEV or TEST result.

diagnosis_judge_frozen.decided_by: user decision of 2026-10-02 (option B): the judge model of the runs so far with the revised, explicit equivalence rules; Sol is an independent audit only
